title: National Laws
description: Law categories with mutually exclusive options (internal politics). Each country always has exactly one active option per category. Category and option ARRAY ORDER IS SAVE-STABLE: saves persist (categoryIndex, optionIndex) bytes, so entries are append-only — never reorder or remove.

country_overrides.description: Curated starting-law overrides keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Each entry maps category id → option id (partial; unlisted categories fall back to ideology-derived seeding). Highest seed priority: override > ideology-derived > gov-type default. CURATION PRINCIPLE: entries encode LEGAL frameworks (constitutional/statutory reality — conscription statutes, state-religion clauses, press-control regimes, Gulf guest-worker systems), never electorate mood: the voter blocs express that. HAND-CURATED — safe to edit directly.

additionalProperties.description: Partial category→option map for one country.

id.description: Internal stable id (e.g. 'conscription'). Mapping key only — never displayed.

name_key.description: Localization key for the category display name (politics.law.category.*).

change_cost.description: Upfront treasury cost (USD) to start changing the law in this category.

cooldown_months.description: Months after a change (or failed vote) before this category can be changed again.

diplo_weight.description: Opinion points at full alignment product. Pairwise opinion contribution = alignA * alignB * weight (see option.diplo_alignment). 0 = category has no diplomatic footprint.

defaults.description: Starting option id per GovernmentType (also seeds old saves). All 10 government types must be present.

id.description: Internal stable id, unique within the category. Mapping key only.

name_key.description: Localization key for the option display name (politics.law.<category>.<option>).

desc_key.description: Localization key for the option tooltip/description.

bloc_stance.description: How each ideology bloc's parties vote on this option: -1 strongly oppose … +1 strongly support. Drives the parliament vote AND decree resentment.

diplo_alignment.description: Position on the category's diplomatic axis (e.g. free press +1 … state press -1). Pairwise opinion = alignA * alignB * category.diplo_weight. Default 0.

drift_target_bloc.description: Ideology bloc this law slowly pulls the electorate toward (PromoteBloc math, like reforms). Null/absent = no drift.

drift_monthly.description: Monthly electorate drift toward drift_target_bloc (share fraction). Default 0.

gate_key.description: Optional doctrine-tier gate ('{branch}_t{tier}', mirrors doctrines.json gate keys). Absent/omitted = ungated (every pre-existing option). When present, the option is unselectable (UI-disabled, AI-skipped, ideology-derived seeding-skipped) until the owning country's CountryDoctrineGates.CompletedTierMask has that branch/tier bit set. Must resolve to a real doctrines.json branch — validated cross-file.

modifiers.description: Gameplay effects while this option is active. Multipliers default 1.0, deltas default 0.

growth_bonus_annual.description: Additive annual GDP growth-rate bonus (GrowthSystem law lane).

unrest_pressure_delta.description: Monthly unrest pressure applied to all owned provinces (positive = more unrest).
